then.text: Sixty thousand and one. The one's your chick. I've given it a number. Don't tell the others.
Go and tell the museum guide. She'll be insufferable about it.
That's a king penguin chick, all right! The brown fluff gave them the name oakum boys: the sealers thought they looked like unpicked rope. Thank you. The count's one up.

else.text: I'm counting kings. One, two, three, four. A chick would be a fine help, for the numbers. A Fieldbook entry would do. Catch an Oakling and show me.
Counting penguins. I'm on nine thousand and something. If you talk to me I'll lose count and have to start again. I don't mind. It's relaxing.
